metadata.lighthouseConfig: Mobile: lighthouse.config.json extends lighthouse:default with no overrides. Screen viewport only is set to 414x896 mobile and 1440x900 desktop to match design references; throttling and scoring remain the Lighthouse defaults.
metadata.chromeLaunch: ChromeLauncher default flags plus headless and no-sandbox required by this Windows runner; Lighthouse scoring/throttling defaults are unchanged
metadata.environment: optimized Vite demo preview with MSW and Socket.IO active
